schema.title: Response List Documents Api V1 Documents Get

post.description:
Upload a file as the raw request body (any Content-Type); metadata goes
in the query string. Processing continues in the background: follow it
with GET /documents/{id}/events.

delete.description: Moves the document to the trash.

get.description: Server-sent events with processing progress until ready or failed.
The original file, always as a download (never rendered inline by the API origin).

schema.title: Response List Pages Api V1 Documents  Document Id  Pages Get

put.description: Replace a page's text with a hand correction (kept on reprocessing).

schema.title: Response Retranscribe Page Api V1 Documents  Document Id  Pages  Page No  Retranscribe Post
Response List Modules Api V1 Modules Get

delete.description: Moves the module (and its topics) to the trash.

delete.description: Moves the topic and its subtopics to the trash.
